name: Studies of a bearded Chinese man and a Macanese woman
summary: These two studies, dated 31 March 1839, were made by Chinnery during his long residence in Macau from 1825 until his death in 1852.  The walking woman wears the traditional Macanese dò, a cape enveloping her head and body; the Chinese man, apparently smiling, has a long beard and a cloth hat.
